description:
Add a new CPT4 billing code to the fee sheet configuration. 

Log in to LibreHealth EHR (admin/password). Navigate to the Administration > Codes section to add a new code.

Enter the following details:
- Code Type: CPT4
- Code: 99458
- Description: Remote physiologic monitoring treatment mgmt, each addl 20 min
- Fee: $42.00
- Active: Yes

Ensure the code is saved and active in the system.
